verification_notes.overall_assessment: W68 successfully delivered 3 of 5 claimed fixes (HeroBlock pills → Link, HeroBlock emoji removed, Constructor legend emoji removed) — these directly resolved 6 specific W67 still_broken items across C48/C49/C50/C51/C52. However: (a) fix #4 'AI photo comments cleaned' is verifiably FALSE (8 comments still in dish-images.ts), (b) fix #5 'Header shadow-sm' is a redundant re-claim of W67 work, (c) FormatShowcase ☕ emoji on homepage is still unresolved, (d) broader emoji policy across halal/allergens/certificates/events/contact/menu pages remains incoherent. Net delta vs W67 is small positive on UX/CRO (pills clickable) and small negative on Frontend (false AI-comment claim + redundant shadow-sm claim). With RED bias -1, median overall drops to 7.9 (from W67 median 8.2). Goal of all ≥9.3 not achieved; gap to target is ~1.4 points on the median.
